subject: english
stem:
A town added a Sunday bus. Shops near the route reported more visitors, but ticket sales did not yet cover the bus cost.
What is the text mainly about?
options: Every town should run free buses
The bus had no useful effect
The Sunday bus brought a benefit but still had a cost problem

optionRationales.reason: Shops saw more visitors：只保留好處，漏掉成本問題。
Every town should run free buses：文章沒有提出普遍政策或免費。
The bus had no useful effect：與 shops reported more visitors 相反。
The Sunday bus brought a benefit but still had a cost problem：同時涵蓋來客增加與票收不足。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「涵蓋全文但不加入未被原文支持的人、時間、因果或普遍結論」可推出 The Sunday bus brought a benefit but still had a cost problem；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The Sunday bus brought a benefit but still had a cost problem 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
